content.title: Samsung Continues Expanding One UI 8.5 Beta Program to More Galaxy Devices
content.text: Building on our ongoing collaboration with Android, Samsung is introducing support for AirDrop through Quick Share3 on One UI 8.5 beta, enabling more seamless cross-platform file sharing for Galaxy users on select devices, including Galaxy S25 series, Galaxy S24 series, Galaxy Z Fold7, Galaxy Z Flip7, Galaxy Z Fold6 and Galaxy Z Flip64. The beta program will continue to expand to additional Galaxy devices later this month. Users can register via the Samsung Members app. 1 The March 2026 One UI 8.5 beta rollout brought support to the Galaxy S24 series, Galaxy Z Fold6, Galaxy Z Flip6, Galaxy S25 FE, Galaxy S24 FE and the Galaxy Tab S11 series. 2 Galaxy Z Fold5 and Galaxy Z Flip5 are supported in Korea and the U.S. only; Galaxy A36 5G is supported in India only. Availability and timing may vary by market. 3 Quick Share feature between Galaxy and Apple devices subject to change without notice and provided by Google.; requires a Galaxy device with Quick Share app version 13.8.51.27 or later and Google Play services version 26.11.xx or later. As of March 2026, “Share with Apple devices” is supported only on Galaxy S26 Series and select flagship models. Quick Share feature between Galaxy devices available with the following OS: smartphones and tablets with Android OS version 10.0 (Q) and One UI 2.1 or above, Galaxy Books released in 2020 or later. Quick Share requires Samsung Account and Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connection. 4 Airdrop support is currently available on the Galaxy S26 series. Availability and timing may vary by market.
